name: Can Can Bunny 6 - I ♥ Mail
original_name: きゃんきゃんバニー６ i･mail
source:
Imaginary city "Shibuya". Mobile phones received a universal spread, and main character decides to get acquainted with modern technologies after a year and a half of job hunting to get advantage at job interviews. After buying mobile phone he wins  navigation communicator called "Monaco" and a CD-ROM from mobile phone manufacturer. It turned out to be a cute girl application!

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/01/vn-of-month-august-2000-tsukihime.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
故事发生在虚构城市“涩谷”。手机已经全面普及，主人公求职一年半仍无结果，于是决定接触现代科技，为面试增加优势。他买下手机后，从手机厂商那里抽中了一台名为“Monaco”的导航通信器和一张CD-ROM。没想到，那竟是一款可爱少女应用程序！

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/01/vn-of-month-august-2000-tsukihime.html]vndbreview[/url]]
